{{Quote|Artoo, that stabilizer's broken loose again. See if you can't lock it down.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Stabilizers''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] components designed to stabilize the craft's power flow into the [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] used a [[phi-inverted lateral stabilizer]].<ref name="SWS" />

Stabilizers were used on many air vehicles and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], including the [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]], the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft]], the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]], the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], and the [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighter]]. They were used to stabilize the craft from veering out of control.

Types of stabilizers included the [[flux stabilizer]], [[Ion flux stabilizer/Legends|ion flux stabilizer]], [[phi-inverted lateral stabilizer]], [[Vortex stabilizer/Legends|vortex stabilizer]], and [[4-axial stabilizer]].

On [[Swoop/Legends|swoopbikes]], the stabilizer extended out from the front of the vehicle and often appeared as a fin, foil or bar.
